d: The Trail Blazers defeated the Nuggets, 118-110 tonight in Denver. Deni Avdija contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 5 assists 3 rebounds and 2 three pointers, with Damian Lillard of the Trail Blazers adding an additional 20 points (5-11 FG, 1-5 3P) in the game. Jamal Murray finished with a team-high 35 points along with 6 assists for the Nuggets in the losing effort. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 5-1 with the win, while the Nuggets fall to 3-3 for the season.
